name: DOM XSS & postMessage Security Auditor
description: Comprehensive client-side DOM Cross-Site Scripting (DOM XSS) and cross-window postMessage security auditor for single-page applications (React, Angular, Vue). Traces execution flows from untrusted DOM sources to dangerous execution sinks, and flags missing or wild-card origin validation in window message event listeners.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

audit_postmessage_origins.description: Inspect window.addEventListener('message') handlers for missing or wildcard (*) origin checks

trace_dom_sinks.description: Detect dangerous sink calls (innerHTML, outerHTML, eval, document.write, setTimeout) with dynamic inputs

detect_sink_gadgets.description: Detect URL-controlled navigation sinks (location.href, window.open, iframe.src)
